name: Armonias Sadistic Theater
source:
At your university, you come across an advertising poster for a tempting opportunity to perform in a theater. The loneliness and boredom in your life compel you to accept it.

[From [url=https://step-on-my-stomatch.itch.io/armoniassadistictheater]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在你的大学里，你看到一张广告海报，上面有一个诱人的在剧院表演的机会。生活中的孤独和无聊迫使你接受它。

[来自[url=https://step-on-my-stomatch.itch.io/armoniassadistictheater]Itch.io[/url]]
